Coram : M.Y. EQBAL*, C. NAGAPPAN
Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 - s. 100 - Second appeal - High Court's Jurisdiction uls. 100 - Scope of - Held: Jurisdiction u/s. 100 is exercised by High Court only when it c is satisfied that there is a substantial question of law - On facts, High Court without formulating substantial question of the judgment passed by the trial court and the first ~ppellate court - High Court failed to notice mandate of s. 100 while deciding a second D appeal - Thus, the judgment passed by the High Court is set aside - Matter remitted back to the High Court to first formulate substantial question of
